findings.desc: docs/requirements/decisions/done-full-test-gate-execution-plan.md:16 says .githooks/pre-push runs package build plus recursive tsc for the self-host repo, and line 38 frames pre-push as a possible narrower build+tsc safety net. The current hook only enters that build/tsc path when packages/main/package.json name equals @koala-agent/core (.githooks/pre-push:147-150), but the current package is @lattice-agent/core (packages/main/package.json:2), so for this repo the hook exits before build+tsc. The document is still right that pre-push does not run root npm test, but it overstates the present release/push assurance surface and should describe the current no-root-npm-test boundary without claiming build+tsc coverage unless the self-host detection is fixed or deliberately scoped.

docs/requirements/decisions/done-full-test-gate-execution-plan.md:147 introduces DONE-blocking missing/failing/stale DONE-required evidence, and docs/requirements/decisions/done-full-test-gate-execution-plan.md:168-175 plans the runner/artifact/DONE oracle row, but the plan never requires updating packages/main/src/core/process-fact-registry.ts, process-fact-levels, or scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs. AGENTS.md:64 and docs/requirements/decisions/story-lifecycle.md:194-195 require every new gate evidence/artifact/process fact to be registered and contract-verified; the comparable 3x2 plan does this explicitly at docs/requirements/decisions/three-round-two-host-review-escalation-execution-plan.md:706-708. As written, the future implementation plan can change DONE gate evidence without the required registry/contract backstop.
